{{Top|leg}}
The '''squintpipe process''' was a weapon system used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Old Republic era]] of [[7700s BBY]]. Following the [[Waymancy Storm]], [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] master crafter [[Lyns Skutroo]] reverse-engineered the [[Sif-Alulan process]] used by the Waymancy weapons to develop the squintpipe process. This resulted in a brief period where rapid-firing [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] outclassed any available [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], until [[7500s BBY]] when further developments in the squintpipe process resulted in stronger deflector shields.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
